ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Funding Pause on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: Investigate the potential impact of the Medicaid funding pause on vulnerable populations in Minnesota, including low-income families and individuals with disabilities.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the Medicaid funding pause for vulnerable populations?
How will the state of Minnesota respond to the funding pause?
ideas.insight: This story would require an analysis of public records and data to understand the potential impact of the funding pause on vulnerable populations. It would also involve interviews with stakeholders, including state officials and advocacy groups.
